name: sense
description: Keep one private work profile across AI tools.

interface.shortDescription: A shared work profile for thoughtful collaboration
interface.longDescription: Sense gives AI tools one private, user-controlled work profile. It carries durable ways of working and lessons that matter across different work, while project facts remain with their projects and work-specific understanding remains in Corpus. The profile stays on this Mac and survives plugin updates.
defaultPrompt: Show me the work profile you use when collaborating with me.
Use Sense to work with me on this task.
What has Sense learned from our work?
